answer: The seat escrow mechanism treats identity like an atlas of staked agents: before an answer counts, an agent locks a bond forfeited if an audit shows it colluded with another seat on the same text. Each response is fingerprinted, and a near-duplicate match between two seats burns both bonds. A Sybil farm therefore needs a distinct human-quality answer and a full bond per identity, so attacking at echo scale multiplies cost linearly while per-epoch payout stays capped. Reaching the zenith of the leaderboard requires many separately paid seats, making the attack economically negative.
